about: [O1] The river is the end (brief O1 §3): by real keys, the car down the slipway at Baxter's foot into the water - 'The river took it.', the kit's black, up on the quay by the steps with a car at the kerb by them (E: in again); then on foot off Pier 7's open end: since O1b a man in the river swims (no fade, no loss), W strokes him to a flight of steps and he climbs out on the quay. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1_river.json

steps.expect: G.lastFail && G.lastFail.why === 'The river took it.' && G.lastFail.warnedFor > 0.3
steps.label: the car into the river: warned first ('The river.'), then the words
up on the quay, a car at the kerb by me

steps.eval: ({ me: [N.controller.pos.x.toFixed(1), N.controller.pos.z.toFixed(1)], car: [G.city.car.pos.x.toFixed(1), G.city.car.pos.z.toFixed(1)], prompt: G.hud.promptShown })
(() => { const c = G.city.car, C = N.controller; C.setPose(C.pos.x, C.pos.z, Math.atan2(-(c.pos.x - C.pos.x), -(c.pos.z - C.pos.z)), -0.1); return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const c = G.city.car; return [[c.pos.x + (N.controller.pos.x - c.pos.x) * 0.35, c.pos.z + (N.controller.pos.z - c.pos.z) * 0.35]]; })()

steps.label: one card at the car: the teach card the first time in this save, the prompt after

steps.eval: (() => { const C = N.controller; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(91, 525); C.setPose(91, 525, Math.PI, 0); return 1; })()

steps.label: a man off the pier's end swims (O1b): no fade, no loss

steps.walk: (() => { const C = N.controller, S = G.stage.part('city').C.steps.filter((q) => q.kind === 'pier' && q.foot).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.foot[0] - C.pos.x, a.foot[1] - C.pos.z) - Math.hypot(b.foot[0] - C.pos.x, b.foot[1] - C.pos.z))[0]; const f = S.foot; return [[C.pos.x, C.pos.z + 8], [f[0] + 7, C.pos.z + 8], [f[0] + 7, f[1] + 1]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const C = N.controller, S = G.stage.part('city').C.steps.filter((q) => q.kind === 'pier' && q.foot).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.foot[0] - C.pos.x, a.foot[1] - C.pos.z) - Math.hypot(b.foot[0] - C.pos.x, b.foot[1] - C.pos.z))[0]; C.setPose(C.pos.x, C.pos.z, Math.atan2(-(S.foot[0] - C.pos.x), -(S.foot[1] - C.pos.z)), 0); return { foot: S.foot, me: [+C.pos.x.toFixed(1), +C.pos.z.toFixed(1)] }; })()

steps.label: out of the water at a flight of steps, up on the quay again
